initialExam.title: NVS PGT 2026 (Navodaya Vidyalaya PGT)
initialExam.description: NVS Post Graduate Teacher recruitment for teaching senior secondary classes in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas across India. Residential schools with excellent facilities.
initialExam.eligibility: Post-Graduate degree in relevant subject with B.Ed
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, General Awareness, Hindi, English, Subject Knowledge (concerned subject), Teaching Methodology.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 150 questions, 150 marks, 3 hours. Part I: 40 marks (Languages, Reasoning, GK). Part II: 80 marks (Subject). Part III: 30 marks (Pedagogy).
initialExam.jobRole: PGT in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (residential posting)
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit navodaya.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Free accommodation, Children education allowance, LTC, NPS
